rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happens often on different occasions.

example.english: I often take the bus to work.
example.traditional: 好多時我都會搭巴士返工。
example.jyutping: hou2 do1 si4 ngo5 dou1 wui5 daap3 baa1 si6 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when emphasizing that something happens very frequently or seems to happen all the time.

example.english: It often rains, so I don't feel like going out.
example.traditional: 成日落雨，我都唔想出街。
example.jyutping: seng4 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dou1 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this more formal choice in writing or careful speech for regular frequent occurrences.

example.english: Large-scale exhibitions are often held in Hong Kong.
example.traditional: 本港經常舉辦大型展覽。
example.jyutping: bun2 gong2 ging1 soeng4 geoi2 baan6 daai6 jing4 zin2 laam5
